as_told.title: Eric Walker: 'We promise not to tell'

plain: Dr Eric Walker was a scientist at Penn State, a university in Pennsylvania. The podcast host Jesse Michels tells how, in the 1980s, researchers went to his office and asked whether he knew anything about UFOs. A researcher who goes by UAPGerb adds that Walker said he had known about Majestic 12, a claimed secret UFO group, for 40 years. He says Walker then answered with a question about ESP, meaning extrasensory perception, the claimed ability to sense things without the normal senses. UAPGerb names the questioners as William Steinman and Henry Azadehdel, and in one version as Styon, and says Walker put on a Don Quixote act. If true, it would mean a respected scientist quietly admitted knowing about a secret UFO programme. Grant Cameron, a researcher, tells it first-hand, saying Walker cut the questioner off and asked what he knew about ESP, and the man had no answer. Cameron dates it to about 30 years ago and says they asked Walker if there had ever been communication, promising not to tell.
